mapper.sql: id, menu_id, parent_id, menu_name, path, component, permission, icon, menu_type, order_num, visible, status, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_menu (menu_id, parent_id, menu_name, path, component, permission, icon, menu_type, order_num, visible, status) VALUES (#{menuId}, #{parentId}, #{menuName}, #{path}, #{component}, #{permission}, #{icon}, #{menuType}, #{orderNum}, #{visible}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_menu SET parent_id = #{parentId}, menu_name = #{menuName}, path = #{path}, component = #{component}, permission = #{permission}, icon = #{icon}, menu_type = #{menuType}, order_num = #{orderNum}, visible = #{visible}, status = #{status} WHERE menu_id = #{menuId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_menu ORDER BY order_num ASC, create_time ASC
SELECT FROM ai_menu WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY order_num ASC, create_time ASC
SELECT FROM ai_menu WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} ORDER BY order_num ASC, create_time ASC

SELECT m.id, m.menu_id, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.path, m.component, m.permission, m.icon, m.menu_type, m.order_num, m.visible, m.status, m.create_time, m.update_time FROM ai_menu m INNER JOIN ai_role_menu rm ON m.menu_id = rm.menu_id WHERE rm.role_id = #{roleId} AND m.status = 1 ORDER BY m.order_num ASC, m.create_time ASC

SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.menu_id, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.path, m.component, m.permission, m.icon, m.menu_type, m.order_num, m.visible, m.status, m.create_time, m.update_time FROM ai_menu m INNER JOIN ai_role_menu rm ON m.menu_id = rm.menu_id INNER JOIN ai_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 1 ORDER BY m.order_num ASC, m.create_time ASC

SELECT DISTINCT m.permission FROM ai_menu m INNER JOIN ai_role_menu rm ON m.menu_id = rm.menu_id INNER JOIN ai_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 1 AND m.permission IS NOT NULL AND m.permission != ''
